senses.gloss:
उल्व उल्व, n.
 1. Amnium, the caul, Ait. Br. 1, 3.
 2. The womb, Bhag. 3, 38.
 --Cf. Lat. vulva.

उल्वण उल्वण (probably akin to उरु, of which the original form has been उर्वन्, cf. εὐρυν-ω for εὐρυνϳω), adj., f. णा.
 1. Abundant, MBh. 3, 340.
 2. Evident, Rājat. 5, 148 (incarnate). []
 --Comp.
